title: Halting in Recurrent Sequence Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.20377v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recurrent sequence models, such as recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and state space models (SSMs), are often trained to emit an end-of-sequence (EOS) token when their output sequence is complete. During training, EOS is treated as another token without a special loss term or incentive. Although this training paradigm is widely used, it is not understood how models decide to output EOS. We study a minimal version of the EOS halting problem in which networks are trained to emit a given input sequence an instructed number of times, followed by EOS. We train tanh RNNs and linear SSMs on this task, finding that the RNNs encode the number of tokens left to copy in a linear subspace, of which two principal components capture most of the variation. Hidden states with the same remaining count converge to a shared representation regardless of their instructed repeat count. translated_title: 循环序列模型中的停止机制
translated_abstract: 循环序列模型，如循环神经网络（RNN）和状态空间模型（SSM），通常被训练为在输出序列完成时发出一个序列结束标记（EOS）。在训练过程中，EOS被视为另一个普通标记，没有专门的损失项或激励机制。尽管这种训练范式被广泛使用，但模型如何决定输出EOS尚不清楚。我们研究了EOS停止问题的一个最小版本，其中网络被训练为按指示的次数重复发出给定输入序列，然后发出EOS。我们在该任务上训练了tanh RNN和线性SSM，发现RNN在一个线性子空间中编码剩余待复制的标记数量，其中两个主成分捕获了大部分变化。具有相同剩余计数的隐藏状态无论其指示的重复次数如何，都会收敛到一个共享表示。通过在边界处使用仿射变换调制隐藏状态……
tldr: 该论文通过一个最小化的EOS停止任务研究了循环神经网络和状态空间模型如何学习决定输出序列结束标记，发现RNN在线性子空间中编码剩余待复制标记的数量，且具有相同剩余计数的隐藏状态会收敛到共享表示。
en_tdlr: This paper investigates how recurrent neural networks and state space models learn to decide when to emit the EOS token through a minimal halting task, finding that RNNs encode the remaining token count in a linear subspace, where hidden states with identical remaining counts converge to a shared representation regardless of the instructed repeat count.
